title: asking for it
subtitle: saying what's wanted, kindly and clearly

steps.text: knowing what you want is one half. saying it is the other.

steps.prompt: someone asks where to eat. try each answer on:
lines: i'd love thai, if you're up for it.
steps.reply: all of them are real answers. the last two give people something to work with.

steps.text: a small, clear want is a gift to the people you're with. it makes deciding easier for everyone.
an easy shape to borrow: "i'd like ___. how about you?"

ideas: a little more time on this

steps.text: a clear want, kindly said, makes things easier for everyone.
say one small preference out loud today, like what you'd rather eat or watch.

grounding.idea: honest, respectful expression of needs and preferences (assertive communication)
